guidance: Review the battery usage information and identify apps or system activities consuming battery.
Check whether an app has unusually high background activity.
Consider whether low cellular signal or notifications contribute to battery usage.
On iPhone 14 and earlier, select Battery Health & Charging.
On iPhone 15 and later, select Battery Health.
Review maximum capacity and any service recommendations displayed.
If a service recommendation appears, consider contacting Apple Support.
Low Power Mode reduces power consumption by limiting certain background activities and features.
On iPhone 14 and earlier, open Settings, tap Battery, and select Low Power Mode.
On iPhone 15 and later, open Settings, tap Battery, select Power Mode, and select Low Power Mode.
Low Power Mode can help extend battery life.
